terms.gloss: the mass of the people, the crowd, the public
terms.grammar: noun, second declension, neuter (in some authors masculine)
evidence: Cic. Planc. 9: nōn est cōnsilium in vulgō, nōn ratiō (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Att. 2.22.3: quod in vulgus grātum esse sentīmus (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Also written volgus. In vulgus, with the public, generally. Of any crowd or throng: vulgus servōrum (Terence, in Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: nōn est cōnsilium in vulgō, nōn ratiō
phrases.english: there is no judgment in the crowd, no reason
